「$n, you will be
　joining $$ミスリル$$'s operation, correct?」

stage0253_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:

「Wherever you go, I am certain
　you will end up fighting Geminis.」

stage0253_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:

「That man $$ガドライト$$...
　He may be twisted, but he seemed quite fixated on
　$$ジェニオン$$ and $c.」

stage0253_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$n
「That's just what I want.
　This time, we'll make the one who underestimated
　our $$ジェニオン$$ regret it.」

stage0253_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood!
　Now I am fired up too!」

stage0253_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:

「Now then, let's get to it today... Business, business!」
